question: Should appGuidedAuth and crestodian.setup.auth.start become supported provider-plugin and Gateway client contracts in this release?
rationale: The PR adds a new user-facing capability and permanent compatibility-sensitive plugin/protocol surfaces under a protected maintainer label; repairing the current defects does not decide that product contract.

options.title: Approve after repairs and proof
options.body: Accept the additive contracts after cancellation reconciliation, public documentation, and exact-head native behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow to internal onboarding
options.body: Keep the native feature but avoid exposing a supported external plugin or Gateway contract until separately designed.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold the PR if this release should not add app-guided provider authentication.

recommendation.title: Approve after repairs and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the additive contracts after cancellation reconciliation, public documentation, and exact-head native behavior proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the contract direction and most recently maintained the central onboarding and manifest paths.
